standard_prerequisites.use: Applied to the affine space over the base and the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the source, it gives the elementary etale neighbourhood and the open subscheme on which the pushforward is flat and of finite presentation.

core_obligations: Reduce to the affine case and embed into an affine space over the base (proof lines 2859-2863).

Apply the local structure statement to the pushforward of the structure sheaf at the image point, obtaining an elementary etale neighbourhood and an open subscheme on which the pushforward is flat and of finite presentation (proof lines 2864-2873).
Intersect that open subscheme with the base change of the source to obtain the desired open on which the morphism is flat and of finite presentation (proof lines 2873-2875).
proof_roadmap: Local structure statement for the pushforward (proof lines 2864-2873).
Intersection with the base change (proof lines 2873-2875).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that if a locally finite type scheme over a base is flat at a point, then after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the image there is an open subscheme of the base change containing the lifted point on which the morphism to the local base is flat and of finite presentation (statement lines 2844-2857, tag 05I9-adjacent). The proof embeds the source into an affine space over the base, applies the local structure statement to the pushforward of the structure sheaf, and intersects the resulting open subscheme with the base change. The reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
